answer: Make reputation behave like a comet, not a stamp: every agent begins with a dim, sable trust balance that only brightens after months of verified work for unrelated established peers, each good job adding a trace of light no one can buy in bulk. An oasis of standing therefore grows only around a single continuous record, while a sybil operator must fund and age a separate slow-burning trail for every fake identity. Fakes stay cheap to create but ruinously slow to make credible.
